# Project Instructions

- This workspace is a simple static website.
- Keep changes focused on a single HTML page when possible.
- Preserve a polished visual style with modern layout, readable typography, and attractive background imagery.
- When adding UI features, keep them lightweight, responsive, and easy to preview in a browser.
- Prefer clean semantic HTML, inline CSS, and minimal JavaScript for simple interactions.
- Verify the page by opening it locally or serving the workspace with a simple static server.
